definitions.full: H5426. nethar [ נְתַר ] verb Haph`el strip off ( נְתַר ᵑ7 fall off ; Syriac ; Arabic scatter ; Assyrian našâru , diminish , shorten , Late Hebrew נָשַׁר fall off ); — Imperative masculine plural אַתַּ֫רוּ (K § 42 b) ) Dan 4:11 (accusative of leaves).
